name: mango creme milk
ingredients_raw: Covering (80%): Sugar, Fractionated Fat (Sal, Palm, Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin)), Milk Solids (18.1%), Cocoa Solids, Cocoa Butter, Emulsifier (322 & 476) & Vanilla Powder. Center Filling (20%): Milk Solids, Sugar, Color (160a (iii)), Emulsifier (322) & Artificial (Vanilla & Mango) Flavoring Substances.
